title: Lady-Bug
summary: LA'DY-BIRD, or LA'DY-BUG, or LA'DY-COW, or LA'DY-FLY noun A small red vaginopennous or sheath-winged insect. A coleopterous insect of the genus Coccinella.(Linne)
